description:
Our state-of-the-art investment casting facility in La Porte, Indiana is seeking a Product Engineer to join our team. Nestled halfway between South Bend and Chicago, along the shores of Lake Michigan - our facility in La Porte, Indiana supplies jet engine components to some of the most trusted names in the Aerospace industry. 
 Job Summary  - This position is responsible for the dimensional integrity of an assigned portfolio of investment cast parts. Responsibility includes the design and acquisition of tooling, fixtures, gauges, and dimensional inspection plans necessary to produce parts that consistently meet or exceed our customers’ requirements and expectations. Also, this position will identify and lead continuous improvement activities to reduce cost, improve scrap and rework yields, and improve the overall efficiency of the manufacturing process.
 Essential Functions 
 Develops and improves processes of critical and complex aerospace components.
 Conceives, evaluates and implements problem solving activities, cost reduction initiatives and part/process improvement activities.
 Job responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:
 Investigates and analyzes root cause of external customer escapes. Develops and implements corrective action plans accordingly.
 Initiates, prepares and validates dimensional qualification packages to meet customer requirements.
 Conducts meetings and provides technical data to meet customer needs.
 Promptly responds to manufacturing issues and addresses root cause.
 Evaluates defects and dimensional integrity of components and determines appropriate actions.
 Defines and implements control plans and FMEA per customer requirements.
 Collects, analyzes and prepares statistical data.
 Conducts design review meetings with customers to ensure production capability on new components.
 Develops production processes that are efficient and within cost estimates.
 Evaluates and implements cost reduction activities.
 Develops scrap and labor costs for cost modeling.
 Defines, solicits and reviews quotes for tooling and cores.
 Attends NPI meetings and provides input based on customer specifications for BOM, routings and milestone plans.
 Defines designs, coordinates construction and validates finished tooling. 
 Collects & analyzes data to appropriately identify, institute, and monitor cost reduction efforts.
 Collects & analyzes data to appropriately identify, institute, and monitor scrap and rework improvements.
 Complies with all EHS rules required for the work environment.
 Performs other duties as assigned.
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 A bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline from an accredited institution.
 1 year work experience in an Engineering role, including co-op or internship experience.
 Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 This position entails access to export-controlled items and employment offers are conditioned upon an applicant's ability to lawfully obtain access to such items.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 3 years' work experience in an Engineering role.
 Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.
 Effective oral and written communication skills.
 Efficient analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Working knowledge of computer applications (i.e. Microsoft Office products, graphics, and statistical analysis software).
 Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
 Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
 Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
 Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
 Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
 Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
 
 Compensation and Benefits: 

 If a pay range is identified for this job, it is based on a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Actual compensation is subject to variation due to factors such as education, experience, skillset, market/business considerations, and/or location. 

 Howmet Aerospace offers a competitive benefits package to support the health, financial well-being, and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include: 

 

 
 Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision benefits coverage, including FSA and HSA account options 

 Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) retirement savings plans offering employer matching funds and a separate employer retirement contribution 

 Paid holidays and vacation time (eligibility, accrual, and usage are discretionary and governed by applicable policies)

 Paid parental leave and adoption assistance programs 

 Life insurance and disability coverage plans 

 Optional coverage plans for auto, home, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance 

 Tuition Assistance Program and ongoing professional development opportunities 

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

 
 Our Story: 

 Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $8.3 Billion in revenue in 2025, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. To learn more about the way Howmet Aerospace Inc. is advancing the sustainability of our customers, markets, and communities where we operate, review the 2025 Environmental Social and Governance report at www.howmet.com/esg-report . Follow: LinkedIn , Twitter , Instagram , Facebook , and YouTube .

 Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
